translation.name: Suha' Maseho: Kadadiam anna Pa'dandiam Bakahu

content: Puang Allataala ussua Yakub lako Betel

Ma'battakada Puang Allataala lako Yakub naua: “Kaom too Puang Allataala to puha umpa'patandaam kaleku indo anna le'ba'ko umpembuniam kakammu Esau. Pa'kalili'ko ammu lako Betel, tohhoko dio anna umpake'de'ko mesa ongeam pehumalasam di Kao.”

Iya nauam Yakub lako sahapunna sola lako ingganna pentuhu'na: “Pa'kalili'koa' aka la le'ba'kia' lako Betel. Diokia' too umpapiamä' ongeam pehumalasam längäm Puang Allataala to umpamoloiä' illaam kamasussaangku anna to ungkambi'ä' illaam pa'laoangku umba-umba kuongei. Sapo' tibe asannia' yolo indo tau-tau to si napa'debatai tau senga' anna umpomasehokoa' kalemu ammu bala'i asanna' pohebamu.”
Iya nahempummi indo tau-tau anna muäläi asanni antim-antinna nabeem Yakub nalamum dio too' kaju tumalumbum ma'sanga sikahuku' kota Sikhem.

Tappana mengkalao Yakub sola sahapunna anna pentuhu'na, iya napalambi'im Puang Allataala kamaheasam lako ingganna tau illaam pa'lembängam ia too, lambi' mahea'i muula' Yakub sola ingganna to napasola.
Iya landa'um Yakub sola ingganna to napasola lako lembäna Kanaan dio kota Betel (indo si diuaam yolona Lus).
Iya umpake'de'um ongeam pehumalasam anna nasangai El Betel.
Aka etam too naongei Puang Allataala umpa'patandaam kalena lako Yakub indo anna le'ba'i umpembuniam kakanna.
Etam too mate Debora indo to si umpaliaha Ribka anna dilamum dio too' kaju tumalumbum ma'sanga, sau'na kota ia too. Iam too anna si diuaammi Too' Kaju Uwai Mata.
Tappana ma'pasule Yakub dio mai Padan-Aram, iya umpa'patandaam oom kalena Puang Allataala lako Yakub anna natamba'i.
Mane ma'kadai Puang Allataala naua: “Iko isangako Yakub, napahandu' temo tä'ungko la disangai Yakub, sapo' la disangaingko Israel.” Susim too Puang Allataala mueli' sanganna Yakub nasangai Israel.
Anna mane ma'kada polei naua: “Kaom too Puang Allataala To Handam Kuasa. La kupalohom banne taummu to la umpangngissi lao mobotto-bottoam, anna la buda mendadi tomahaja.
Anna indo pa'lembängam to puha kubeem Abraham sola Ishak la kubeengko sule lako pessubummu.”
Tappana puha, le'ba'um Puang Allataala umpellei indo ongeam naongei umpa'tula'i Yakub.
Iya muosä'um batu Yakub, tanda pengkilalaanna, mane natolloi anggur sola minnä' napehumalasam längäm Puang Allataala.
Mane nasangai Yakub indo ongeam naongei Puang Allataala ma'tula', Betel.
Mate Rahel indo anna undadianni Benyamin
Puhai ia too le'ba'um Yakub sola ingganna to untuhu'i umpellei Betel. Tappana la landa' kalei lako Efrata, iya lambi'um wattunna la keänä' Rahel, sapo' mapahhi' keänä'.
Masäei mangnguhiba', tuttuam mapi'di' nasi'dim. Iya nauam indo to ma'pakeänä': “Pomatohoi penabammu Rahel aka la muane oo änä'mu.”
Sapo' abana inna la lambi'um ia tempona Rahel la mate. Tappana la kattu penabanna, iya nahakkusam siapi ussangai änä'na Ben-oni,
sapo' nasangai ia ambena Benyamin.
Susim too kamateanna Rahel lambi' dilamum dio ampe' lalam lako Efrata. (Indo Efrata disangaim temo Betlehem).
Naosä'um batu Yakub natandaiam indo ku'bu'na Rahel anna da'da' liupi sule lako temo.
Puhai ia too, umpatahhu'um pa'laoanna Israel lambi' umpake'de' bahunna tando lakona Migdal-Eder.
Tappana tohhoi dio ongeam ia too, iya indo Ruben umpempakoi baine lolä'na ambena isanga Bilha. Kaha-kaha ia too naissam siam Israel. Peänäsanna Yakub 35:22-26 Änä'na Yakub sapulo dua muane.

content.text: Lea undadiam Ruben (änä' uluana Yakub), Simeon, Lewi, Yehuda, Isakhar, anna Zebulon.
Rahel ia undadiam Yusuf anna Benyamin.
Bilha, sabua'na Rahel, undadiam ia Dan anna Naftali.
Zilpa, sabua'na Lea, undadiam ia Gad anna Asyer.

content: Padam too inde peänäsanna Yakub muane dadi dio Padan-Aram.
Kamateanna Ishak
Iya landa'um Yakub lako Mamre sikahuku' Kiryat-Arba (battu diua Hebron), ongeam naongei tohho Ishak, ambena. Ongeam iam too si naongei Ishak anna Abraham.
Indo Ishak tä' deem pada samahendem. Sahatu' kahua pulo taunna tubo mane matei, lambi' le'ba' sungnga'na ma'mesa sola nene to naponene. Iya nalamummi Esau sola Yakub, änä'na.

footnotes.text: El Betel: kalembasanna, Puang Allataala tandaam dio Betel.
Ben-oni: kalembasanna, änä'ku muane mapi'di'ä' undadianni.
Benyamin: kalembasanna, änä'ku muane to umbaba hongko'.
